title: 11th Word: Construction of the Palace and Appointment of the Explaining Master

questions.question: What did the king decide to build?
questions.answer: A huge and beautiful palace.

questions.question: How did the king make the palace look special?
questions.answer: He filled it with jewels, beauty, and skillful art.

questions.question: What did the king place in the palace after finishing it?
questions.answer: Big tables of tasty food and many blessings.

questions.question: Who did the king invite to the palace?
questions.answer: His people and subjects from all over his land.

questions.question: Why did the king choose a chief leader as a teacher?
questions.answer: To explain the palace, its maker, and the meanings inside it.

questions.question: What were the helpers of the teacher doing in different parts of the palace?
questions.answer: They were helping teach people in each area.

questions.question: Where did the main teacher stay?
questions.answer: In the biggest room with his students.

questions.question: What kinds of things was the teacher supposed to explain about the palace?
questions.answer: Its decorations, jewels, art, secrets, and proper manners there.

questions.question: Why did the teacher teach the people the right way to act?
questions.answer: So they would behave the way the king wanted.

questions.question: What was the king’s purpose in building the palace?
questions.answer: He wanted a grand place to show many wonderful things.

questions.question: How was the palace divided inside?
questions.answer: Into many fine rooms and living spaces.

questions.question: What did the king use from his treasures in the palace?
questions.answer: Many kinds of precious jewels.

questions.question: How can we tell the king was very generous?
questions.answer: He prepared rich meals and invited many people.

questions.question: What was special about the food tables?
questions.answer: Each group had a table made for them.

questions.question: Besides food, what else were the guests meant to do?
questions.answer: Look at the amazing palace.

questions.question: What important job did the teacher have?
questions.answer: To tell the people the palace’s purpose and what its things meant.

questions.question: Why did people need someone to explain the palace?
questions.answer: Because its beauty and details had meanings they might not know by themselves.

questions.question: What did the teacher explain about the jewels and decorations?
questions.answer: That they pointed to the owner’s skill and greatness.

questions.question: What can we infer about the king since he did not appear himself?
questions.answer: He wanted the people to learn through the teacher he sent.

questions.question: What did the king do first with the palace?
questions.answer: He had a great palace made.

questions.question: How did the king decorate the palace?
questions.answer: With fine art, wisdom, and valuable jewels.

questions.question: What was set on the tables in the palace?
questions.answer: Delicious foods and many gifts.

questions.question: Who came to the feast and show?
questions.answer: The king’s people from every part of his country.

questions.question: Whom did the king appoint after preparing the palace?
questions.answer: A highest leader to be a teacher.

questions.question: What did the teacher explain about the art inside the palace?
questions.answer: What it was pointing to and what it showed.

questions.question: What did the teacher teach about behavior in the palace?
questions.answer: The correct manners for looking at and understanding the things there.

questions.question: Why were assistants placed in each part of the palace?
questions.answer: So teaching could reach people in every area.

questions.question: Was the palace small and plain, or large and grand?
questions.answer: Large and grand.

questions.question: What made the palace beautiful to look at?
questions.answer: Jewels, decorations, and beautiful works of art.

questions.question: Who prepared the palace decorations and design?
questions.answer: The king himself prepared and arranged them.

questions.question: What came after the palace was completed?
questions.answer: A big banquet was prepared.

questions.question: How were the banquet tables organized?
questions.answer: A fitting table was chosen for each group.

questions.question: What two main things were the guests invited to do?
questions.answer: Eat and look at the display.

questions.question: Why was a teacher needed in the palace?
questions.answer: To explain the palace’s purpose and teach people its meanings.

questions.question: What did the teacher tell people about the decorations and jewels?
questions.answer: That they had secrets and showed the owner’s perfections and arts.

questions.question: What did the teacher explain about ceremonies?
questions.answer: How they should be done the way the king wanted.

questions.question: What kind of place did the king build?
questions.answer: A very big and noble palace.

questions.question: What did the king add from his treasure houses?
questions.answer: Many precious jewels.

questions.question: What shows that the king was skillful, not only rich?
questions.answer: He adorned the palace with fine art and careful design.

questions.question: What was the banquet like?
questions.answer: It was rich, beautiful, and full of delicious food.

questions.question: Did the king invite only a few people or many people from across the land?
questions.answer: Many people from across the land.

questions.question: What new person did the king appoint later?
questions.answer: A chief commander to be a teacher.

questions.question: What was the teacher meant to make known about the palace?
questions.answer: Its purpose, its meanings, and its maker.

questions.question: What did the teacher explain about the things inside the palace?
questions.answer: He explained what they showed and why they were there.

questions.question: What did the king build because of his purpose?
questions.answer: A splendid palace.

questions.question: Name one way the king made the palace lovely.
questions.answer: He decorated it with jewels and beautiful art.

questions.question: What filled the broad tables in the palace?
questions.answer: Many kinds of delicious food and blessings.

questions.question: Why did the king prepare different tables for different groups?
questions.answer: To give each group a fitting place and meal.

questions.question: Why were people called from all around the kingdom?
questions.answer: To enjoy the feast and see the palace.

questions.question: Who was chosen to teach the visitors?
questions.answer: A top commander.

questions.question: What did the teacher help people know about the palace owner?
questions.answer: His qualities shown by the palace and its contents.

questions.question: What did the teacher explain about the fine designs inside the palace?
questions.answer: That they pointed to the owner’s great skill and excellence.

questions.question: Why did the teacher tell people how to act while looking at the palace?
questions.answer: So they would show the right manners.

questions.question: What happened before the teacher spoke to everyone?
questions.answer: He stayed in the largest room with his students while helpers were in the other areas.
